label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
Parameter (N)
derivation: Sequential integer assigned per unique PARAMCD

label: Baseline Value
derivation: AVAL from the record where ABLFL='Y' for the same USUBJID and PARAMCD; baseline defined as the last non-missing assessment on or prior to the date of first exposure (TRTSDT) per SAP Section 8.3 and 11.5 (Visit 1, Week -2)

label: Baseline Type
derivation: 'LAST NON-MISSING ON OR PRIOR TO TRTSDT'

label: Baseline Record Flag
derivation: 'Y' for the record selected as baseline per BASETYPE rule; blank otherwise

label: Analysis Visit
derivation: Mapped from LB.VISIT/VISITNUM per SAP Section 8.2 assessment windows for laboratory assessments: Baseline (Visit 1), Week 2 (Visit 4), Week 4 (Visit 5), Week 6 (Visit 7), Week 8 (Visit 8), Week 12 (Visit 9), Week 16 (Visit 10), Week 20 (Visit 11), Week 24 (Visit 12), Week 26 (Visit 13); unscheduled/retrieval visits mapped to the appropriate window based on LBDTC relative to randomization date

label: Analysis Visit (N)
derivation: Numeric equivalent of AVISIT: Baseline=0, Week 2=2, Week 4=4, Week 6=6, Week 8=8, Week 12=12, Week 16=16, Week 20=20, Week 24=24, Week 26=26

label: Analysis Date
derivation: datepart of LB.LBDTC; partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW

label: Analysis Relative Day
derivation: ADT - TRTSDT + 1 if ADT >= TRTSDT else ADT - TRTSDT

label: Analysis Normal Range Indicator
derivation: Derived per SAP Section 8.3: 'L' if AVAL <= LBSTNRLO; 'N' if AVAL > LBSTNRLO and AVAL < LBSTNRHI; 'H' if AVAL >= LBSTNRHI; blank if normal range limits missing

label: Baseline Normal Range Indicator
derivation: ANRIND value from the baseline record (where ABLFL='Y') for the same USUBJID and PARAMCD

label: Last On-Treatment Record Flag
derivation: 'Y' for the last record per USUBJID and PARAMCD where ADT <= TRTEDT (or last dose date) and AVISITN <= 24 (Week 24) per SAP Section 8.3; blank otherwise

label: Derivation Type
derivation: Blank for original records; 'LOCF' for imputed post-baseline efficacy records per SAP Section 8.1 (though LOCF applies to efficacy, not lab); 'AVERAGE' if multiple values averaged within a window; otherwise as applicable per CDISC CT

label: Threshold Lower Limit (0.5 * LLN)
derivation: 0.5 * LBSTNRLO per SAP Section 8.3 threshold range definition

label: Threshold Upper Limit (1.5 * ULN)
derivation: 1.5 * LBSTNRHI per SAP Section 8.3 threshold range definition

label: Threshold Range Indicator
derivation: 'L' if AVAL <= A1LO; 'H' if AVAL >= A1HI; 'N' otherwise per SAP Section 8.3 and 8.4.1

label: Baseline Threshold Range Indicator
derivation: ANRINDT value from the baseline record (where ABLFL='Y') for the same USUBJID and PARAMCD

label: Shift from Baseline (Normal Range)
derivation: Concatenation of BNRIND and ANRIND (e.g., 'N to H') per SAP Section 11.5 shift table requirement

label: Shift from Baseline (Threshold Range)
derivation: Concatenation of BNRINDT and ANRINDT (e.g., 'N to H') per SAP Section 11.5 shift table requirement

label: Ratio to Normal Range Lower Limit (AVAL/ANRLO)
Ratio to Normal Range Upper Limit (AVAL/ANRHI)
Change from Previous Scheduled Visit
derivation: AVAL - AVAL of the previous scheduled visit record (by AVISITN) for the same USUBJID and PARAMCD per SAP Section 8.3

label: Percent Change from Previous Scheduled Visit
derivation: 100 * CHGPRV / AVAL of previous scheduled visit per SAP Section 8.3

label: Abnormal Flag (Significant Change from Previous)
derivation: 'Y' if ABS(CHGPRV) > 0.5 * (ANRHI - ANRLO) per SAP Section 8.3; blank otherwise

label: Hy's Law Criteria Flag
derivation: 'Y' if (PARAMCD in ('ALT','AST') and AVAL > 1.5 * ANRHI) and (exists record for same USUBJID and AVISIT with PARAMCD='BILI' and AVAL > 1.5 * ANRHI) per SAP Section 8.3; blank otherwise

label: On-Treatment Flag
derivation: 'Y' if ADT <= TRTEDT (or last dose date + washout per SAP Section 8.1); blank otherwise
